messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air given temperature and volume. They have a container of volume 2.5 m^3 at temperature 300 K, then at 350 K, then at volume 1.5 m^3 at presumably same temperatures? Actually they say: "I will repeat the experiment at higher temperature 350 K, then at lower volume 1.5 m^3 next repeat the experiment." So they have three conditions: (V=2.5 m^3, T=300 K), (V=2.5 m^3, T=350 K), (V=1.5 m^3, T=350 K?) Wait, they said "then at lower volume 1.5 m^3 next repeat the experiment." It might mean at lower volume 1.5 m^3 at the same temperature 350 K? Or maybe at 300 K? The wording: "I will repeat the experiment at higher temperature 350 K, then at lower volume 1.5 m^3 next repeat the experiment." It could be interpreted as: first experiment: V=2.5 m^3, T=300 K. Second experiment: V=2.5 m^3, T=350 K. Third experiment: V=1.5 m^3, T=350 K. But maybe they want V=1.5 m^3 at 300 K? The phrase "next repeat the experiment" might refer to the same temperature as the previous experiment? Hard to parse.

But the user says: "I have a container of volume 2.5 cubic meters and can keep temperature at 300 K. I will repeat the experiment at higher temperature 350 K, then at lower volume 1.5 cubic meters next repeat the experiment." So they have three conditions: (V=2.5, T=300), (V=2.5, T=350), (V=1.5, T=350). But maybe they want (V=1.5, T=300) as well? They mention "in all these experiments I use air." They ask: "Can you provide the heat capacity for these three different conditions?" So they want three values.

We need to use the function calc_heat_capacity. The function signature: temp: number, volume: number, gas?: string. The default gas is air. So we can call the function three times.
